title: Server-side HTML sanitising for rich text
summary: MyAPES Account can now safely store and show formatted text. Anything unsafe, such as scripts, is removed when text is saved and again when it is shown.
changes: Add server-side cleaning for formatted text, keeping headings, lists, links, tables and images.
Remove scripts, event handlers, inline styles, embedded frames and unsafe links.
Older plain text keeps its line breaks and is shown safely.
version_rationale: Minor: starts the v0.50 rich text epic with an approved new dependency (mews/purifier); no data change.
validation: New feature test for removing scripts, event handlers, unsafe links, frames and styles, keeping safe formatting, cleaning on save and safe display.
known_limitations: No field uses formatted text yet; the editor arrives in a later release.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No data changes.
provenance: Milestone v0.50.2 Beta, issue #484 under epic #481, pull request #619.
